description: Give any track an authentic vinyl feel — procedurally generated crackle, pops and surface hiss mixed into your audio.

faqs.a: Crackle is synthesized from scratch: sparse random impulses with exponential decay (pops) plus filtered noise (surface hiss). No samples are used.
faqs.q: Is the crackle real or a sample?

faqs.a: The crackle mix, pop density and hiss level are all adjustable so you can go from subtle warmth to battered flea-market record.
Yes — generation and mixing happen in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

howto: Set crackle intensity, pop density and hiss.
title: Vinyl Crackle Adder
